scope: general CNF, ordinary DAG resolution, one fixed recognizer-plus-DELAY decider
result: B2_A holds for A_slow with p(z)=z^2, while B1_A fails by Haken 1985 on canonical PHP; neither universal B2 nor B3 proved

logic.R: binary resolution, one unit per distinct derived non-tautological resolvent
logic.individual_B1_failure: W_R(PHP_k)>=2^{Omega(k)}; canonical N_k=O(k^3 log(k+1)); A_slow runs poly(N_k) on this family

model_space: rho >= 1 for N-bit counter in real DELAY implementation; no FLMV margin
bibliography: Armin Haken (1985), The Intractability of Resolution, doi:10.1016/0304-3975(85)90144-6
Cook and Reckhow (1979), The Relative Efficiency of Propositional Proof Systems, doi:10.2307/2273702
